text:
alex (sec): Heads-up: External pen test scheduled for Tue 2026-07-12. We need an RBAC change inventory, KMS access mapping, and an audit log sampling plan for evidence. Who owns the remediation tracker?

tara (eng-infra): I can start the RBAC inventory. Will pull from terraform state + IAM console. Quick Q: do we include service accounts used only by Dedicated nodes?

alex (sec): Yes include Dedicated + Private service principals and any short-lived assume-role flows. We need which keys have decrypt rights.

mike (sre): I can do KMS mapping. My plan: list key ARNs, principals with kms:Decrypt, and last_use timestamp. Will add to the tracker.

jen (product): Flagging: any keys that touch customer PII must be called out separately and pre-approved for assessor access. Also we need a blameless timeline for changes.

alex (sec): Good call. Let's split tracker sections: RBAC inventory, KMS mapping, Audit log sampling (log retention windows + examples), and Remediation actions + owners. I'll own the tracker and assign items.

deploy-bot: New issue created: #SEC-pen-test-2207 assigned to alex (sec) — https://issues.redwood/internal/SEC-2207

tara (eng-infra): Quick snippet I'll run to map role bindings (will paste results to tracker):

```
# list roles referencing kms
terraform state list | grep aws_iam_role || true
aws iam list-role-policies --role-name <role> | jq -r '.PolicyDocument.Statement[] | select(.Action=="kms:Decrypt")'
```

mike (sre): For audit logs: sampling plan proposal — capture 48h of KMS CloudTrail events, 72h of token and auth events, and 7d of deployment/CI events. We'll redact user identifiers in exported evidence unless approved.

alex (sec): Timeline: RBAC + KMS inventory by Fri COB, draft audit sampling by Mon, remediation plan (owners + ETA) by Mon EOD so we can brief assessors Tuesday morning.

jen (product): Can we add a canary change window for any RBAC fixes that touch prod? Suggested: small window Tues 9–10am with rollback playbook.

mike (sre): Agree on canary. I'll prepare rollback commands and health checks. Example rollback snippet for role detach: 
```
aws iam detach-role-policy --role-name infra-agent --policy-arn arn:aws:iam::aws:policy/ReadOnly
```

alex (sec): If anyone finds keys with cross-account decrypt, flag immediately. That will be highest priority for mitigation.

tara (eng-infra): I'll post initial RBAC table in the tracker in ~2 hours.

alex (sec): Thanks — will kick off remediation spreadsheet and assign. Ping here if blockers. :thumbsup:
